title: Pesticides and Parkinson´s Disease
official: Prevalence of Preclinical and Prodromal Parkinson´s Disease in Subjects Exposed to Pesticides
summary: The aim of this project is to study whether people exposed to pesticides have a higher risk of developing PD. We will perform an epidemiological study determining the presence of pesticides in urine and comparing signs traditionally associated with PD in early forms.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Farmers exposed to pesticides for cases
* No work exposure to pesticides for controls

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects without signed consent form
* Neurological significant conditions
